instruction: Change the copyright notice text to red color.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires the user to change the copyright notice text (paragraph 2: 'Copyright © 2022 Intellectual Property Office of Singapore') to red color. The evaluator checks if the text runs in that paragraph have RGB color close to red (255, 0, 0) with a tolerance of 20 for color variations.
metadata.verification: Verified by examining document structure. Paragraph 2 contains the copyright notice. Agent needs to select this text and change font color to red using Format > Character > Font Effects or toolbar.
